subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

I will come to yours house in the evening to play chess.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is:** to yours house**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace '**yours**' with '**your**' to make the sentence correct.
 
• The words **yours **and **your **are often confused because they are easy to mistype.
 
 
• **Your **means a form of the possessive case of you when used as a pronoun.
 
• **Yours **means that which belongs to you (singular); the possessive second-person singular pronoun used without a following noun when used as a pronoun.
 
 
 
• **Your **has an object; **yours **is the object.
 
• Here,** Your **is used as an adjective that means **"relating to or belonging to you."** In the given sentence '**your**' should be used because it is referring to the person, whose house the narrator is going to visit.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**, which contains an error.

**Corrected sentence:** *I will come to **your **__house in the evening to play chess.*
